title: Topical Finasteride in the Treatment of Idiopathic Hirsutism
brief_summary: the purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy of topical Finasteride in the treatment of idiopathic hirsutism
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Idiopathic hirsutism which is defined as normal levels of androgens and normal ovulation
* Normal serum prolactin

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
* Simultaneous use of other drugs for the treatment of hirsutism
